Lines.en: heya soooo i finally found a way to control those rouge ugly thingys
Lines.zh: 嗨呀 我总算学会控制这些四脚奇行种了

Lines.en: remember how i trapped zomboss? only had to torture him for a day and he told me everything LOL
Lines.zh: 记得我把僵王抓走了吗？只严刑逼供了一天他就全招了哈哈哈哈哈哈

Lines.en: THAT IS SOOOOOOOOO COOL! Give me a go on that giant robot!
Lines.zh: 这也太帅了吧！快让我试试这个机甲！

Lines.en: no no no it's all mine >=) oh hey what does this button do?
Lines.zh: 不行 你不许玩 >=) 诶这个按钮是干嘛的？

Lines.en: I thought you said Dr. Zomboss told you how to operate this...
Lines.zh: 你不是说僵王告诉你怎么操作机甲了吗……

Lines.en: he told me how to use this machine, but he didn't tell me there's so many fun buttons to press
Lines.zh: 他是告诉我怎么操作机器，但是他可没告诉我有这么多好玩的按钮可以按

Lines.en: ohhh seems like i have access to every zombie in the game! then why zomboss never summons a TON of these tall guys during his first phase
Lines.zh: 哇哦看起来我能召唤所有僵尸诶！话说为啥僵王不一阶段就召唤一大堆傻大个呢

Lines.en: I have a bad feeling about this...... Good luck, neighbour!
Lines.zh: 总有种不祥的预感……祝你好运，邻居！
